get.description:
GET  app://self/auth        → returns the authorization URL the client should redirect to
POST app://self/auth        → exchanges {code, state} for an AuthenticatedUser

The bound AuthInterface decides the backend (Google in production,
FakeAuthProvider in test / fake-hal-api-app).

WriteResponse.title: WriteResponse
WriteResponse.description: Permissive shape covering POST/PUT/DELETE response bodies across all write resources. PUT returns {id}, POST returns {id, slug|email|filename}, error paths return {message, id}. Each write method points its #[JsonSchema(schema:)] at this file.

AuthResponse.title: AuthResponse
AuthResponse.description: POST /auth response. Subject `id` is the OAuth provider's user identifier (opaque string), not a DB integer. Failure path returns {message, reason}.
